name: transit
title: Buses (Valley Regional Transit)

commands.name: match-routes
commands.help: put unlabeled bus trips on routes by their path (the transit stream does this)

commands.name: transit-progress
commands.help: match bus fixes to their routes for playback, or report on a window (the stream does this)

commands.name: transit-ribbons
commands.help: rebuild the side-by-side route ribbons and colors (vrt_gtfs does this daily)

commands.name: route-colors
commands.help: print the route palette table and its checks

storage: Every changed GTFS-realtime feed is archived as published ($TVT_ARCHIVE/vrt-gtfs-rt/, polled every 30 s) and each static GTFS zip ($TVT_ARCHIVE/vrt-gtfs/); one row per bus fix in obs.vehicle_position and obs.vehicle_progress. Not yet measured.
ethics: Buses are public vehicles tracked by their operator's open feed; bus numbers are vehicle IDs, not people. CC BY 3.0: credit Valley Regional Transit.
